role: Observable signal whose `version` Int bumps (coalesced over 80 ms) whenever `.flowRecoveryArchiveChanged` is posted, so SwiftUI views refresh on archive mutations without observing the whole RRCollector.
types: ArchiveSignal: class (@MainActor @Observable) — coalesced archive-change version counter
state: mem:ArchiveSignal.version (private(set), observed by MainTabView, HistoryView, TrendsV2View, MorningResultsView, FitnessPostSummaryView, CoachHomeV2View, LoadTrajectoryLoader, SettingsPages+Data, FitnessTabView+Strap)
notif:.flowRecoveryArchiveChanged (observed and posted; name declared elsewhere)

units.does: Stores the notification center and registers a queue:nil observer for `.flowRecoveryArchiveChanged` (any object) whose block hops to the main actor and calls scheduleCoalescedBump().
units.entry: Constructed only by RRCollector.init when no signal is injected (RRCollector.swift:701, `archiveSignal ?? ArchiveSignal()`) and by snapshot tests (e.g. EmuquTests/TabScreenSnapshotTests.swift:43); there is no separate dependency-container construction. The observer block is invoked by NotificationCenter on the posting thread (SessionArchive.archive, notifyChanged, other posters).

units.does: Cancels any pending coalesce task and removes the notification observer from the injected center.
units.entry: Swift deinit when the signal is released.

units.does: Cancels the previous coalesce task and starts a new main-actor task that sleeps 80 ms and, if not cancelled and the object still exists, increments version (wrapping add). Trailing debounce: a stream of posts closer than 80 ms apart cancels each pending task, so only the last one bumps, 80 ms after the last post.

branches.cond: task cancelled after sleep, or self deallocated
branches.effect: returns without bumping (the newer task, if any, bumps); otherwise bumps version

units.does: Posts `.flowRecoveryArchiveChanged` (object nil) on the injected center; the bump itself happens via the observer registered in init, and every other raw observer of that name (TrainingMetricsCache, HeatAcclimationCache, BeatConsistencyPriorsCache) also fires.
